Here's a few general tips. In addition, we strongly recommend using [QGIS User Manual](https://docs.qgis.org/3.40/en/docs/user_manual/index.html)

## Keyboard Shortcuts

Change the below to QGIS things like F7 for Style Manager and CTRL + . for digitising

| Hotkey | Description |
| --- | --- |
| <kbd>F6</kbd> | Open Attribute Table |
| <kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>J</kbd> | Zoom to Selection |
| <kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>Alt</kbd>+<kbd>T</kbd> | Toogle Processing Toolbox |
| <kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>Shift</kbd>+<kbd>Tab</kbd> | Hide all panels (good for georeferencing) |
| <kbd>F7</kbd> | Open Layer Styling Panel |
